Add discovered TV: Add this TV to the adapter
Allow on the TV: The TV will ask whether ioBroker may control it. Click OK, then select "Allow" on the TV within 20 seconds.
Device management description: Scan, add, pair, rename, and remove TVs here. Device changes are applied immediately.
Discovered device: TV discovered on the local network
Enter PIN: Enter the PIN shown on the TV
IP or MAC required: An IP or MAC address is required.
Manual add description: Add a TV that could not be discovered automatically.
Name: Name
Name validation error: Use only letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores.
Pair now?: Pair the TV now? It must be switched on.
Remove confirmation: Remove this TV, its credentials, and its complete object tree?
Scan description: Search the local network for Samsung TVs.
Scenes help: A scene sends several keys, apps and inputs one after the other, e.g. HOME, YOUTUBE, WAIT 3000, OK. Steps: keys (HOME, UP, SELECT or OK, BACK, 1, VOLUP, KEY_...), apps (YOUTUBE, NETFLIX, DISNEY_PLUS...), inputs (TV, HDMI1, HDMI2...) and pauses (WAIT 2000). Every scene gets a button <TV>.scenes.<name>. Begin with ON to switch the TV on first; without it a scene runs only while the TV is on.
Send a test key?: Send a test key? The TV then shows its info banner.
Set up the inputs now?: Set up the inputs (HDMI, TV...) now? Newer TVs switch the input only over the source menu, whose order has to be entered once.
Setup done: The TV is set up and can be controlled with its states.
Source menu help: Press SOURCE on the remote control: the TV shows the connected devices. Enter the entries to the right of SmartThings in their order, separated by commas, e.g. TV, HDMI2, USB. Only connected inputs are listed. Leave empty if the TV switches the input with the direct keys (HDMI1...).
Stable identity note: The MAC address is used to follow DHCP address changes. The friendly name defines the object path.
Test key not seen: The TV accepted the key but did not react. Check that it is switched on and that the connection was allowed on the TV, then pair again.
Test key sent: The INFO key was sent. Does the TV show its info banner?
Token changed: The TV returned a different token. Nothing was saved.
Token rejected: The token is invalid or was rejected by the TV.
Token verification unavailable: The TV could not be reached to verify the token.
